cim: Tendam appoints former Orange executive Mónica Sala to lead its artificial intelligence strategy - FashionNetwork
cim_eredeti: Tendam appoints former Orange executive Mónica Sala to lead its artificial intelligence strategy - FashionNetwork
szoveg_eredeti:
Tendam, a Spanish group that includes brands such as Cortefiel, Pedro del Hierro and Springfield, has appointed Mónica Sala, formerly of Orange Spain, as chief AI and transformation officer to lead the company’s AI strategy and transformation programmes.

Sala, who will take up the post on January 1, 2027, will join the group’s executive committee and report directly to Jaume Miquel, Tendam’s chairman and CEO, the company said in a statement.With this appointment, the fashion group is strengthening its commitment to AI as a strategic capability to drive growth and profitability.

In her new role, Mónica Sala – who joins from Orange Spain, where she sat on the executive committee and led areas such as strategy, B2B, systems and networks – will head up the group’s AI strategy and transformation programmes to create value from data and technology, enhance the customer experience across all brands and channels, and move towards more efficient, agile operations."Artificial intelligence is part of our growth strategy and builds on an advantage we have been developing for years: our knowledge of the customer and the integration of our channels. We now want to extend this capability across the entire value chain, with a clear priority: turning it into business results,” said Tendam’s chairman and CEO, Jaume Miquel.For her part, Mónica Sala said she is embarking on this new phase with “enormous enthusiasm.” “Artificial intelligence is a historic opportunity to reinvent how we design, produce, sell and interact with our customers, and Tendam has everything it needs to lead that transformation in its sector,” she stressed.Tendam currently has around 30 AI use cases in place across its business and is working towards their progressive integration throughout the entire value chain.
